evidence.detail: hide_intro determined by cookie 'hide_intro', session, MTGO username, or Discord ID — all fail in Discord iOS in-app browser which does not persist cookies across sessions
Also sets hide_intro after 10 'views' cookie increments — still cookie-based, same problem
JS shows .intro-container if data.hide_intro is falsy — depends entirely on the server-side cookie check
navigator.cookieEnabled is true in Discord iOS browser; $.cookie test also returns true; User-Agent is normal Safari; no viable client-side detection found

triage.notes: Owner explored several approaches (navigator.cookieEnabled, JS cookie probe, UA detection) and all failed. The viable options are: (1) embed a hide_intro=1 query parameter in Discord bot links so the box never shows from bot-generated URLs, (2) accept the regression, or (3) server-side IP/fingerprint heuristics. All require an owner judgment call.
